entities.name: AusP A0A0F7TQP2
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Penicillium brasilianum O-acyltransferase AusP; annotated in fungal meroterpenoid acetoxydehydroaustin biosynthesis.
Reference annotation reports O-acetylation of austinol to austin; downstream spontaneous change to dehydroaustin.
Sequence length 482 aa; predicted mass 54.85 kDa and pI 7.57.
Pfam transferase domain PF02458 detected at residues 155–412.

entities.name: Acetoxydehydroaustin biosynthesis
observations: Penicillium brasilianum gene-cluster pathway produces the fungal meroterpenoid acetoxydehydroaustin; AusP is annotated as an O-acetyltransferase in the pathway.
